fields.label: Web address
fields.description: The public page to show. Use HTTPS; plain HTTP works only for private addresses when this installation allows it.

fields.label: Background color
fields.description: Shown behind the page while it loads.

options.label: Keep the last page that loaded

fields.label: Allowed hosts
fields.description: Exact host names the page may navigate to. The page's own host is always allowed. This limits top-level navigation, not every third-party resource.

fields.label: Custom user agent
fields.description: Leave blank for the Player's standard user agent. Overrides can break sites.

widgets.name: YouTube
widgets.description: Play a public YouTube video, playlist, or live video.

fields.label: YouTube video or playlist URL
fields.description: Tilecast detects whether this is a video or a playlist. No YouTube API key is required.

fields.label: End at (seconds)
fields.description: Leave blank to play to the end.

fields.label: Caption language
fields.description: A language code such as en or es. Leave blank for YouTube's default.

fields.label: Timezone
fields.description: Leave blank to use the organization timezone.

deprecation.message: Create a Clock and choose Date instead. Saved Date content keeps working.

widgets.name: QR Code
widgets.description: Display text or a URL as a scannable code.

fields.label: Link or text
fields.description: What the code opens or says when scanned. Keep it short so the code stays readable from a distance.

fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Tells viewers why they should scan.

fields.label: Short label
fields.description: A short line under the code, such as the domain.

fields.label: Style
fields.description: Standard pairs the code with its text. Code only shows the code alone for small zones.

fields.label: Background color
fields.description: Keep it light so the code scans reliably.

fields.label: Code color
fields.description: Keep it dark so the code scans reliably.

deprecation.message: Create a QR Code instead. Saved QR Code content keeps working.

widgets.name: World Clock
widgets.description: Show live time in multiple configured timezones.

fields.label: Zones
fields.description: Up to eight zones. Leave a label blank to show the city name.

deprecation.message: Create a Clock and choose World clocks instead. Saved World Clock content keeps working.

widgets.name: Stat Grid
widgets.description: Display a responsive grid of numeric values.

fields.label: Data Source
fields.description: The records or single-object source these metrics read.

fields.label: Metrics
fields.description: Up to twelve numeric values. Each names its own field.

fields.label: Columns
fields.description: Legacy grid width. Old Players still read it; the component lays itself out.

deprecation.message: Create Metrics instead. Saved Stat Grid content keeps working.

widgets.name: School Status Banner
widgets.description: Displays a school status, severity, message, and update time.

deprecation.message: Use Status for new Widgets. Saved School Status Banner Widgets keep working.

dataSources.description: Project a public RSS or Atom feed into typed records. The Server detects the feed form and normalizes it to one records contract.

setup.tip: Tilecast fetches the feed on the Server; Players only receive the normalized cached records. Publisher presets fill in a trusted feed address.

dataSources.description: Project a public Atom feed into typed records.

deprecation.message: Create an RSS / Atom Feed instead. Saved Atom sources keep working.

Save and select it in a Status Widget.

steps: Enter a status, message, and severity.
Optionally set effective and expiration times.
Connect this source to a Status Widget.
